answer_1.quote: We propose an approach to integrate a concise encoding of knowledge graphs into a Transformer-based decoder architecture for knowledge-grounded dialogue generation.

answer_2.quote: At training time, we use perplexity on the validation subset as the stopping criterion. Table lists the results for all models estimated on the test set.

answer_4.quote: The evaluation study was managed by researchers not involved in setting up the models and experiments. They recruited 20 participants not familiar with our research and the goals of the study.
answer_4.guideline: Participants mark utterances that entail or contradict the dialogue context, rate dialogues on a 7-point Likert scale for naturalness, consistency, and interestingness, and choose between dialogues.
